text.description_html:
Emtek Rope Lever Keyed Entry with Round Rope Rose, EMT-51x1R

From Emtek's Classic Brass Collection. Round rope rosette combined with elegantly appointed Rope lever.

Features:

  • Adjustable for 1-3/8" - 1-3/4" Thick Doors
  • Standard 2-3/8" Backset - Optional 2-3/4" Backset
  • Strike: Standard Full Lip with Square Corner
  • Latch: Standard Square Corner Faceplate
  • Fits all pre-drilled Doors
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Handed Levers
  • Sold as Complete Set
  • Solid Brass Construction
  • Easy to Install

Available Functions:

  • Entry Lever: Key on outside, turn button lock on inside.
  • Dummy Pair: Rigid - For use as a pull or to match trim.
